entries.en: an unworthy person; a man of no ability
entries.notes: 西语词头拼写残乱不可解，汉字栏又标才/在之疑，仅据音写栏与『不才人』定释。

entries.en: it is not there; not present

entries.zh: 还没备办停当；未便（尚未就绪）
entries.en: it is not ready; not yet prepared
entries.notes: 西语指未备妥，汉字栏『辨未便』之辨当读如『辦』，音写栏末二字即『未便』之习语。

entries.en: it is not ripe; not yet mature
entries.notes: 音写栏首音当为否定词之记音，与汉字栏『那』不能密合，释义依西语与『熟』字定。

entries.en: not awake; has not woken up (Spanish reads 'no está maduro')
entries.notes: 西语栏作『不成熟』，与汉字栏『醒』义不合，或原件西语本为『despierto』而封存件误录。

entries.en: no harm; it does not hinder, never mind

entries.zh: （与娼妇）过夜而不付钱；通宵不寐
entries.en: to spend the night with a bad woman without paying; to sit up all night
entries.notes: 西语 mala muger 指娼妇，与『曠冥』（通宵）之对应仅据文意推得，音写栏末有星号，疑有脱字。

entries.en: to spend this night (with a bad woman) without paying; an idle night
entries.notes: 西语作『esta noche』，汉字『空冥』与音写栏首音声母不协，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 一言不发，也不辞别（对人冷落不理）
entries.en: to say nothing to someone and not even take leave; to give the cold shoulder
entries.notes: 汉字『恕然』与音写栏不能密合，仅据西语『no hablar, ni despedirse』定释。

entries.en: to ignore someone; to be wanting in courtesy
entries.notes: 西语『no hacer caso』与汉字『不礼』义近而不全同，音写栏首音与『不』之常式不合。

entries.en: don't mind him; to pay no attention to someone
entries.notes: 音写栏多出『不睬』一音而汉字栏未列，故降为中。

entries.en: cannot find it (what was lost); to search in vain

entries.zh: 寻不着；找不到所寻之物
entries.en: to seek and not find
not to live to old age; to die young
entries.notes: 音写栏与『無年已』不相应，疑与上二条串行，仅据西语定释。

entries.zh: 变不出来；无法变出（东西）
entries.en: cannot be changed out; cannot produce anything by transforming
entries.notes: 西语栏言『传不到消息』，与『變不出』不合，音写栏与汉字栏则相合，存疑。

entries.en: it is not in my power; not up to me
there is very little (to say); few words
entries.notes: 西语『vay, ay muy poco』文义不明，『無話』与末一音之对应亦不清。

entries.zh: 不要欺侮人（原件后半残缺）
entries.en: do not wrong or oppress others (text incomplete)
entries.notes: 西语栏残，音写栏后二音无汉字可对。

entries.zh: 命有根；命硬，不会死得那么快
entries.en: his life has roots; he is tough and will not die so soon

entries.zh: 命有力；命硬，不会这么快就死
entries.en: his life has strength; he will not die so soon
〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 四栏皆空，仅西语栏存残字，无从定释。

entries.zh: 该说的话不遗漏；不把该讲的略去不说
entries.en: not to leave unsaid what one ought to say
entries.notes: 汉字仅存『詢』，音写栏第二音污损难辨（T99），释义主要据西语栏。

entries.en: there is nothing one can say; no words to say
entries.notes: 末字疑为『未/末』，音写栏后二音无确对汉字。
